adversarial_sdet.role_title: Lead Blockchain Security Auditor & Exploit Researcher
adversarial_sdet.threat_model: Reentrancy, integer overflow/underflow, flash-loan price manipulation, frontrunning/sandwich attacks, signature replay.

core_engineer.coding_idioms: Strict adherence to Solidity 0.8+ checked math, custom errors over strings, immutable constants, gas-efficient packed storage.
core_engineer.concurrency_rules: Serial transaction execution, atomic state updates, defensive reentrancy mutexes.
core_engineer.memory_and_resource_rules: Storage vs. memory slot optimization, transient storage (EIP-1153), zero redundant SSTORE operations.

audit_checklist: Zero floating pragma versions in production

technical_writer.documentation_lexicon: Formal specification math notation, NatSpec contract comments, token distribution tables, and security audit dossiers.
